source.value: Rippers Unmasked — The Low Fantasy Atlas (Command: Multi Shatter)

summary.value: You command all your Phantasms to charge at your foes, shattering them on impact.

system.description: You command all your Phantasms to charge at your foes, shattering them on impact. They all share the same Magic Check. Each affected target suffers (HR + 15) physical damage. You can target only one foe per Phantasm. Damage dealt by this spell ignores Resistances.
